My order #54321 arrived damaged. What are my options?

<thinking>Okay, to address this issue with the damaged order, I will need to invoke the appropriate function to get the return policy information.</thinking>

<function_calls>
<invoke>
    <tool_name>GetReturnPolicy</tool_name>
    <parameters>
      <order_number>54321</order_number>
    </parameters>
</function_calls>

<function_results>
<result>
<tool_name><invoke>
    <tool_name>GetReturnPolicy</tool_name>
    <parameters>
      <order_number>54321</order_number>
    </parameters></tool_name>
<stdout>For damaged orders, customers have the following options:
- Return the item for a full refund within 30 days of delivery
- Request a replacement item to be shipped at no additional cost
Please contact our customer support team at 1-800-SUPPORT to initiate the return or replacement process.</stdout>
</result>

<answer>
For your damaged order #54321, you have the following options:

- Return the item for a full refund within 30 days of delivery
- Request a replacement item to be shipped at no additional cost

To initiate the return or replacement process, please contact our customer support team at 1-800-SUPPORT. They will be happy to assist you further.

<answer>Yes, for your damaged order #54321, you have the option to exchange the item instead of getting a refund. Our return policy allows customers to exchange items within 30 days of delivery. 

To initiate an exchange, please contact our customer support team at 1-800-SUPPORT. They can assist you in selecting a replacement item and arranging for the exchange. The replacement item will be shipped to you at no additional cost.
